---
name: team-conventions
description: How Fernhill Labs writes Linear tickets, Slack updates and spec changes. Use when creating or updating tickets, posts or specs.
---
- Linear titles: imperative, <70 chars. Description: context, decision source (meeting/Slack link), acceptance criteria.
- Slack updates: 3 lines max — what changed, why, who to ask.
- Spec changes: never edit silently; add a "Changelog" line with date and decision source.
